nodes.meaning: A request must display one primary target before submission. Selecting another surface must not silently retarget an existing draft or an already submitted request.
nodes.invariant: submit(request) => target(request) = displayed_target_at_submit; target(submitted_request) is immutable. unresolved(target) => clarification, not dispatch.
nodes.failure: If the selected target disappears or its revision becomes invalid, preserve the draft, mark the target unresolved, and ask for a new selection before a targeted action.

nodes.meaning: A surface must identify the work it presents, its selected context, its readable space needs, and its availability. Changing presentation must preserve the underlying work identity.
nodes.invariant: surface_identity != work_identity; context_reference = (work_identity, revision_or_unknown, selection); unavailable(surface) does not imply absent(work).
nodes.failure: Show unavailable or stale state when context cannot be resolved. If space is insufficient, keep the active surface readable and make others reachable through compact entries.

nodes.meaning: A proposed layout must show its reason and preview before explicit application. Applying it must preserve working state and retain a way to restore the preceding arrangement.
nodes.invariant: proposed -> previewed -> applied | dismissed; changed_base_layout => proposal_stale; apply requires current_base and satisfied_pins.
nodes.failure: Reject stale proposals and explain which layout changed. A pin conflict must not silently unpin a surface. Viewport constraints can produce a temporary fit fallback without overwriting the preferred arrangement.

nodes.meaning: A pinned choice must retain its declared role or placement against layout proposals until the user explicitly changes or removes that pin.
nodes.invariant: pinned(choice) and not explicit_user_change(choice) => proposal_preserves(choice); fit_fallback does not erase(preferred_choice).
nodes.failure: When constraints cannot all fit, explain the fallback and preserve the stored preference. Do not silently remove a pin or make the composer unreachable.

nodes.meaning: Layout changes, chat expansion, and surface switching must preserve draft text, selected target, artifact selection, and reading position within the active prototype session.

transitions.guard: Stable fallback selected while preserving draft

nodes.invariant: layout_transition(s) => retained(draft, target, selection, reading_anchor); restore(layout) does not rollback(artifact_content).
nodes.failure: If a source revision removes the selected location, preserve draft text, report the missing anchor, and show a stable fallback. Do not claim an exact restored position when it no longer exists.

nodes.meaning: A request for attention must identify its associated work, reason, and current state. It must become noticeable without replacing the active task or stealing keyboard focus.
nodes.invariant: attention = (identity, work_reference, reason, state); acknowledge != resolve; navigate_to_attention requires user_action.
nodes.failure: If the source disconnects, mark the attention state stale. Dismissing or acknowledging a notice must not imply that the task succeeded or the underlying decision was approved.
